stylingNotes: Lilac (jacaranda) panel left with H2, two paragraphs and two arrow links separated by rules; full-bleed lab photo right overlapping panel.

Sandstone (light peach) panel left with H2 "Our network", two paragraphs and a "Become a member" underlined arrow link; member-event photo right, bleeding to the viewport edge and overlapping the panel bottom.

Full-width lilac (jacaranda, #d6dbeb) band; image LEFT inset inside the band (cmp-teaser--std, image-left, not overlapping); right: uppercase date eyebrow 'Thursday, 10 September', serif H2 'I Have a PhD, Now What?', paragraph and an underlined orange 'Register' text link.
visualCharacteristics.variantRationale: Lilac text panel beside full-bleed overlapping image
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Lilac text panel beside full-bleed overlapping image

contentPattern.structure: one row with two cells: [optional date eyebrow paragraph, H2, paragraphs, standalone links (one per paragraph) | image]. Image cell second = text panel beside a bleeding, overlapping image; image cell first = event/news teaser with the image inset inside the band. One link renders as an underlined text link, two or more as a ruled arrow-link list

blockContent.description: H2 'Our research', two paragraphs, links 'Drug Discovery research' and 'What is drug discovery?' beside a lab image
blockContent.notes: section-3: 2 cells [text+links | image]; section-6: 3 cells [H2 | icon link list | Email/Media enquiries headings + mailto links]

reuseGuidance: Use for a highlighted topic that links onward. Put the image cell second for image-right with a bleeding image, or first for an event/news teaser with the image inset in the band. Add the sandstone option for a sandstone panel (default is jacaranda).
usageDescription: Feature panel: heading, short paragraphs and a ruled list of arrow links beside a large image that bleeds to the viewport edge.
